newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar consolidates in listless session.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar consolidates in listless session.

text.p: White sugar futures stayed gently firmer on Monday but activity was light due to national holidays and a dearth of fresh fundamental news, traders said. The two nearby contracts dominated the overall turnover, with around half of the 666 lots traded coming from trades of the December/March spread. A December cross of 100 lots also boosted volume, they said. At 1511 GMT December stood 80 cents firmer at $329.50 and March was up 20 cents at $329.00. Traders said a public holiday in Japan and the Jewish holy day of Yom Kippur had contributed to the market torpor.
Traders and analysts said market sentiment in London was still bearish in light of the weakness seen last week.
"It's still consolidating and waiting for the next move lower," said one trader.
Activity in Paris was similarly lacklustre, with December up 50 cents at $329.50 and March down by the same amount at $329.00. Matif volume amounted to 866 lots.
